notes: Labels use the SAM3X8E/ATmega16U2 port names (PAxx/PBxx...) from the 'Micro' column as GPIO names; Arduino names (D54/A0, D21/SCL...) follow in functions, read outward from the pin. Image 1 (c27ea43d) shows the 2x18 D22-D53 header and the other small headers without labels, so they are not transcribed from it; images 3-4 grey out the main headers. Skipped: LEDs (TX/RX/TXL/RXL/LED_BUILTIN/Power), 6-20 V barrel jack, ERASE button (PC0), ATMEGA16U2 PA8/PA9 to SAM3X PD3/RX, PD2/TX internal link. OUT/IN power tags omitted. Image 5 prints 'DATRG/WKUP[5]' on D19/RX1 (copied as printed).
